requirements.note: This summary-level communication requirement is represented even though individual subordinate requirements R10, R21, R22, R24, and R37 have noted gaps.

verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: Versioned ingestion and consistent publication: content hashing, new/changed/unchanged handling, supersession and stale-record deletion, metadata-preserving chunking, three-store writes, same-version gating, unavailability of partial writes, and repair/rollback are all represented strongly.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: The board omits the required batch-isolation behavior that unaffected documents continue processing when one document is unparseable. Secondary gaps are the weak linkage of embedding failures to retry/dead-letter handling, no dead-letter reprocessing path, and an underspecified low-confidence fallback branch.
verdict.coverage_summary: Weighted coverage is 0.9156, which would meet the rubric's raw 8-level coverage threshold. However, R10 is an absent system-defining failure behavior, so the mandatory cap limits RC to 6. The architecture, permission-aware retrieval, grounded/cited answers, consistent publication, feedback loop, and generation rebuild/rollback contract are substantially covered, but the board cannot fully replace the brief because batch continuation and parts of failure recovery remain incomplete.
